says: Today's tooling: `sh .agents/skills/lead/scripts/leakgrep.sh` with no arguments reads a diff from standard input, so an agent that runs it bare, as lane briefs say, waits forever with no message.
proof: On 2026-11-15 three agent shells on this laptop had a bare `leakgrep.sh` running, at 2, 12 and 49 minutes, each blocked in `cat` on stdin with nothing printed. The same script with `--commits origin/<branch>..HEAD` read 8 commits and answered in seconds.
cost: Each stuck run holds an agent until its tool timeout and leaves a process behind, and the push it guards waits or goes out without the check.
